Title: Totally irrelevant post to do with artwork

Messages.Author: jibbajibba
Messages.Body:
It might just be us but the general feeling was that artwork on the NoR
expansion was the weakest for a while. I am sure Larry Snelly has
entered a new 'Slop it on and take the cash' Period comparable to Piet
Mondrian drawing 3 red lines and a square on a white canvass and asking
for 2 years average income for it (having said that I quite like
Hannibal137 and Composition with Red, Blue, and Yellow is okay).

Over the years Jyhad artwork has been varied. We had that great phase
where they pursuaded John Bolton and a few others to do some great
artwork and we had the early Quinton Hoovers and when Larry Snelly was
misprinted as Larry Schnelli his art was great (Smudge you still reign
supreme). Then we had Agatha et al. Things started to look up then we
had the Christopher Shy monopoly and the chris and Larry duopoly.

Surely WW can fork out some cash and get some decent artists in ... and
how about consistancy across a clan. I for one would love to see the
next expansion (Return of the Sabbat or whatever) feature 14 new
Lasombra all drawn by Brom or a baker's dozen Tzimisce penned by Tim
Bradstreet. Even if these guys are too expensive there are a host of
top notch comic artists that I am sure would appreciate the extra cash
Travis Charest, John Cassaday etc etc.

Just tell me who I need to sleep with to make this happen....

The benefit isn't automatically applied just for "being around a long
time."

Magic can afford expensive artists because they sell so many cards.
V:TES cannot.

Don't actually know what artists are paid for Magic cards but they
could probably even get the artists to do the art for free. If you do
Magic art, the door is opened for selling large quantities of prints
and other money-making merchandise. I don't think V:TES has that same
appeal for big name artists.

-Robert
